description: This Java class 'XmlSchemaValidator' validates XML strings against an XML Schema Definition (XSD). It loads the schema from a string or file path, sets up schema validation, and provides a method to check if an XML string is valid according to the schema.

classes.name: XmlSchemaValidator
classes.description: A validator class for XML strings against an XSD schema, with schema loading and validation logic.

methods.name: XmlSchemaValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the schema validator with a schema string or file path, setting up schema validation.

methods.name: buildSchemaFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a SchemaFactory instance with security properties.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates an XML string against the loaded schema, returning an error message if invalid or empty string if valid.
